user.title: Set up Pakete Tracker
user.description: Choose which parcel carriers are shown in the overview. Sign in to the carriers afterwards via "Configure".

error.no_carriers: Please select at least one carrier.

email.title: Connect mailbox
email.description:
Shipping and delivery notifications are read from your mailbox (read-only, mails are not marked as read). Amazon orders and parcels from DPD, GLS, Hermes, DHL and UPS are detected automatically.

Gmail: use an app password (imap.gmail.com).

data.days: Search mails of the last … days

data_description.password: Leave empty when editing to keep the current password.

dhl.title: Sign in to DHL
dhl.description: DHL offers an official tracking API. Create a free API key: developer.dhl.com → register → "Create App" → add API "Shipment Tracking - Unified" → copy the API key (250 requests per day).

ups.title: Sign in to UPS
ups.description: UPS offers an official tracking API. Create credentials: developer.ups.com → "Create Application" → product "Tracking" → copy Client ID and Client Secret.

error.no_carriers: Please select at least one carrier.

add_package.name: Add parcel
add_package.description: Adds a parcel by tracking number (Amazon: order number).

remove_package.name: Remove parcel
remove_package.description: Removes a parcel from the overview.
